meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会把每个 git 分支、工作树或 PR 当成虚拟参会者，让它们轮流发言、对比改动、协商冲突，最后给出统一合并计划。过程只读，不直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你要求跨多个 git 分支、工作树或 PR 对比改动并产出一个合并方案时触发；也可指定时间窗口（如1小时/24小时）来自动挑选活跃分支参与。

say.text: 给这几个分支开个 standup，比较各自改动，给我一个合并计划。
say.note: Claude 会分轮次主持并把结论总结给你。

say.text: 以过去24小时为窗口，让活跃工作树讨论如何合并。
say.note: 会先按窗口筛选参会分支再开始。

say.text: 把 develop 和 PR #12 拉进来，梳理冲突并给出合并顺序。
say.note: 只读对比并出计划，不会替你合并。

howto.what_en: Each git worktree/branch/PR becomes a virtual participant; they talk in a shared read-only log, compare changes and conflicts, and produce one merge plan. Claude does not merge or edit code itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered by user requests to compare multiple git worktrees/branches/PRs and produce one merge plan, or by choosing a time window (e.g., 1h/24h) for active worktrees.

say_en.text: Run a standup across these branches, compare changes, and give me a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude will run turns and summarize the conclusion.

say_en.text: Considering activity in the last 24h, have active worktrees discuss how to merge.
say_en.note: It filters branches by the chosen window first.

say_en.text: Pull in local develop and PR #12, sort out conflicts and give merge order.
say_en.note: Read-only; actual merging is done later, not by Claude here.
